$d="$HOME\reelmon"; New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory $d | Out-Null; $b=''; $ms=[IO.MemoryStream]::new([Convert]::FromBase64String($b)); $gz=[IO.Compression.GzipStream]::new($ms,[IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress); $sr=[IO.StreamReader]::new($gz,[Text.Encoding]::UTF8); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$d\reelmon.py",$sr.ReadToEnd(),[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); $py = if (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {'python'} elseif (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {'py'} else {throw 'Python nao encontrado. Instale: winget install Python.3.12'}; & $py -m pip install -q flask; & $py "$d\reelmon.py" start; & $py "$d\reelmon.py" status; & $py "$d\reelmon.py" panel
